(nya)༄༅/ /skyer sgang nas brgyud pa'i rta mchog rol pa'i sgrub thabs yid ches pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rab dmar byi ru'i lhu

tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// skyer sgang nas brgyud pa'i rta mchog rol pa'i sgrub thabs yid ches pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rab dmar byi ru'i lhun por mi sbyin skyes// 'char ka'i 'od khyab dran pas log 'dren bgegs// 'joms pa'i mthu chen thob na rta mchog gi /bsgom bzlas rjes 'gro de yi sgrub thabs 'dri// de la 'di'i rjes su gnang ba thob pas rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar 'dod pas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes pa'i skyabs 'gro ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang gzhan sems can thams cad dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan pa sogs kyis tshad med bzhi spyi ltar bsgoms pa rnams ni bsod nams kyis tshogs so// oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas 'khor 'das gnyis snang gi chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur par bsams pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// dngos gzhi lhar bskyed pa ni/

stong pa'i ngang las yi ge e yongs su gyur pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba/ phyi rol nas ye shes kyi me dpung kha dog sna lnga 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa/ de'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥdamar po ring cha tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rta mchog rol pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa rtsa zhal dmar po g.yas ljang g.yon dkar ba zhal gsum ka'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ dbu gsum gyi steng na rta mgo ljang zhur gsum rta skad mtsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas dmyal ba yan chad mes rwa ba dang gur gyis khyab pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga gsum pa na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po na sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pa na mdung*/ gsum pa na rgyu zhags bsnams pa/ mgrin pa nas long bu'i bar khro chung mtshon gang pa kha gdangs shing mig bgrad pas gtams pa/ glang chen gyi ko rlon dang zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ khrag gi thig le dang zhag gi zo ris thal chen gyi tshom bus byug pa/ mi skra'i tshangs skud dang rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bzhi bskums shing g.yon bzhi brkyang bas klu brgyad kyi ngo bo sbrul brgyad brdzis pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs pa de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su hrīḥde las 'od zer 'phros pas au rgyan dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ
zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang du bya'o// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ lha thams cad kyi zhal

'dir thugs kar sngags phreng bkod pa mi dgos pa yi ge rnying pa'i dgongs pa ltar yin zhes rgyal dbang lnga pa sogs kyis gsungs/ nas sngags kyi sgra sgrogs pa dang*/ 'od zer dpag med 'phros pas 'phags pa rnams mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ rigs drug sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal sbyangs/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnod pa dang nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad tshur bsdus te rang la thim pas nus mthu dang gzi brjid thams cad rgyas par bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥpad+man+ta krita badz+ra kro ta h+ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas/ bsnyen pa sngon du ma song na sngags kyi sham bu bzla mi rung ba gsungs shing*/ bsnyen pa song bas rtsa sngags la sham bu btags pa cung zad bzla bar 'dod na/ dbang du bsdu ba'i sngags/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yo/ trig nan dza dzaḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ las sngags/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya bzlog sa ma ya bh+yo/ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dza dzaḥrnams sbrel nas nyer gcig bzla/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mchog rol pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang*/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi gnod pa thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas/ myur du rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba btab nas lha sku mi dmigs pa'i ngang du cung zad mnyam par bzhag la/ slar rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gtor bsngo bya ba dang*/ min na rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ zhes gsal gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rta mchog rol pa 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces dang*/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa sogs// gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo yis// shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis// ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog

/ces bsngo ba dang smon lam gyis rgyas gdab bo// thun mtshams lta bur gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma bran te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ gtor mgron gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e yig yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim pa'i bar gong bzhin bya ba'am/ bsdu na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas au ḍ+yān mkha' 'gro'i gnas/ dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas nas khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu gtor ma la zugs te gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar i dam ba liṃ ta grih+na pa ya gṛh+na pa ya kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes btags pa lan gsum mam lngas phul/ oṃ h+ya grī wa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhūp+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod la/ bstod pa ni/ hrīḥrgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gdung*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas rngam chen sku// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo// khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhus la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hās brtan bzhugs bya/ med na oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bskyed yod na/

dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs sngar ltar bya'o// dran pa tsam gyis log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs// mthar byed rta mchog rol pa sgrub pa'i thabs// mkhas grub zhal lung dri med a mṛ ta// skal ldan don gnyer bde legs gsos su sbyin// 'dis mtshon dge bas mar gyur 'gro ba rnams// snang srid lha 'dre'i 'tshe ba las rgyal nas// gnod bya gnod byed bde bar rnal du gnas// brtse gcugs byams pa'i bran du 'khol bar shog /ces skyer sgang nas brgyud pa'i rta mchog rol pa'i sgrub thabs yid ches pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sde dbon don 'grub dbang rgyal gyi ched du/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i tshul gyis ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes btags pas bris pa swasti bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru ha ya gri wā ya/ phul byung lha sngags ye shes 'bar ba'i mes// gdon bgegs 'byung po'i bud shing yongs bsregs nas// thal bar bgyid pa khro rgyal rta mchog gi /rjes su gnang ba cho ga'i lag len 'dri// 'di'i rjes gnang la/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ stegs bu ras sogs kyis bkab par me tog gi sil ma cung zad bkram ste/ maṇ+ḍal la 'bras sogs kyi tshom bu bkod/ de'i steng mañdzi'i steng du dpal gtor dmar po rgyan ldan/ de'i mdun du 'bul gtor zlum po zhig kyang bshams pa'i mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis bskor ba dang*/ rang gi mdun du rdor dril me tog sogs mkho ba'i yo byad bsham mo// gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon rang nyid kyis mchod pa rnams badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyi bsang*/

swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon zhabs bsil sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ dang dharmā ra ṇi bcas pas spyi ltar byin gyis brlabs/ 'di'i sgrub thabs skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i mjug gi 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa'i bar gong bzhin nyams su blang ngo*// mdun bskyed tshom bu gtor ma dang bcas pa la dmigs te bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas sogs nas/ gnyis ka dbyer med du lhar bskyed nas ye shes pa mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par bstim pa'i bar bdag mdun gyi khyad par cung zad ma gtogs 'dra/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs gong ltar byas la/ oṃ ha ya gri wā sa pa ri wār re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis bar gyis mchod/ spyan ras gzigs sprul hrīḥlas khro bo'i sku// chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad pa// rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes pas bstod/ 'bul gtor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥlan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ mdun bskyed kyi ljags las 'od kyi sbu gu byung bas gtor ma gsol bar mos la/ oṃ hrīḥpat+mān+ta kṛta sogs sngags kyi mthar/ i dam ba liṃ gṛh+ṇā pa a gṛh+ṇā pa ya/ kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul la mtshan sngags sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ bstod pa gong bzhin gyi mthar/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la zhes sogs nas/

yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyi 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gzhi bdag la gtor ma yod na 'bul/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa ci nus byas rjes/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pas bdag dang slob ma rnams kyi nad gdon bgegs rnams zhi zhing tshar gcod pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas slob ma bos te gral du 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa ste/ de'ang dpal ldan shangs pa bka' brgyud par brgyud pa rin chen sna bdun du grags pa las/ brgyud pa lnga pa dbon ston skyer sgang pa de nyid kyi mnal lam 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang las dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams su bgrod de/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa las chos gsan par mdzad/ khyad par shing pho rta'i lo dgun zla rwa ba'i tshes bcu bdun gyi tho rangs mnal lam bzung nas/ au ḍ+yān mkha' 'gro'i gnas dpal ri pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas su byon/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang zhal mjal te/ de yang bod na chos byed pa spyir lha srin sde brgyad dang khyad par te srog bdag rgyal 'gong gis gnod 'tshe che bar 'dug pas/ de'i gnyan por rta mgrin gyi sgrub pa khyad par can zhig thugs la 'dogs par zhu zhus pas/ slob dpon chen po de rta mgrin dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug pa cig tu gyur nas rta skad theng gsum bton pas/ snang srid kyi ma mo la sogs pa der 'dus/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo tshul bzhin du byas nas/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa la rta mgrin gyi dbang bskur bar mdzad/ 'di skor gyi gdams pa rnams snye mo nas sngags pa zhig gis gter nas spyan drang ba yod pas de la'ang zhus shig gsungs/ mnal sad pa dang rim gyis gter ston rgya gangs ri ba sangs rgyas dbang chen zhes/

thang yig tu 'byung ba'i snye mo gzhu yas gnod sbyin 'bar zhes pa'ang 'di'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs yin pas de las gter byon gyi gdams pa rnams kyang zhus pas bka' gter chu bo gnyis 'dres su gyur te/ 'di'i sgo nas 'gro phan shin tu che ba byung bas/ rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs zhes phyogs kun du grags pa byung*/ de'i brgyud pa drug pa gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnang*/ des zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsgrubs pas zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ dbus kyi dkar chung rgyal po la sogs pa dkor bdag rnams 'khrugs te/ gnod pa'i smyo ba brgyad cu tsam yang 'di'i sgo nas btul/ rgyal po khos glags lta ru byung ba la byams snying rje tshad med du bsgoms pas/ khos gus pa'i sgo nas phyag zhum zhum btsal/ de phyin chad khong la zhe nas mos shig gting nas thul ba yin gsungs/ des 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa la gnang*/ de nas bzung ste bdag cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyi bar du brgyud de byon pa yin pas yid ches pa'i gnas su mdzad 'tshal/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i rjes su gnang ba'i rim pa 'bul ba la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams grub zin/ slob ma la bya ba'i ngo skal du gyur pa la/ slob dpon khro rgyal rta mchog rol par gsal ba la rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// 'jig rten gsum gyi 'dren mdzad lha// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyob// rdo rje'i bla mar mdzad du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du/ khyed rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas rjes zlos mdzod/

dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ rjes gnang gi gzhi lus bsgrub pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang ba zhu/ slob dpon rta mchog rol par gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po tsha zhing sreg pa bzod par dka' ba dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas sku tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang nad gdon bgegs dang rnam smin gdos bcas kyi phung po bsregs sbyangs/ byang zhing dag par byas/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de la dmigs pa oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes pa nas/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed/ de rnams gzhi dgod pa yin/ dngos gzhi la/ dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba dang*/ lha dngos kyis byin gyis brlabs pa gnyis su yod pa'i dang po'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du gnang bar zhu/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka rta mchog rol pa dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud byas pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gtor ma gnyis ka rta mchog rol par gsal ba'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po skya bun 'phros pa'i sna las rta mgrin dkar po sku chung la yan lag rags pa me dpung 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang nad gdon thams cad zhal du dmar 'jil gyis gsol/ sku lus kyi me dpung gi 'od kyis kyang gzhob thul gyis bsregs/ ro ma rnams kyang mtshon cha sna tshogs bas gtubs/ sku dges pa'i gar mdzad/ gsung sngags kyi sgra bsgrags pas lus sems kyi steng du bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed/ bum dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs byung snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/

hrīḥpad+ma ta krita sogs brjod cing rol chen nam dril gsil bya/ zhes pa ni sku'i byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ de bzhin du gnyis ka'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po bun gyis 'phros pa'i sna las rta mgrin dmar po sogs sngar ltar rigs 'gre zhing*/ sngags brjod dril gsil bya/ 'di la ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i zhes dang*/ gsang dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur/ de bzhin du thugs la dang*/ yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i zhes dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhes sogs 'don pa bsgyur/ lte ba nas 'od zer mthing ga 'phros pa'i sna las rta mgrin mthing ga sku chung la zhes pa nas/ sngags dang dril gsil gyi bar rigs 'gre/ 'di la yang lus ngag yid gsum ka'i sgo nas bsags pa'i zhes dang*/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs ma lus bzhugs/ zhes sogs 'don pa cung zad bsgyur/ zhes pa'i sku gsung thugs gsum char gyi byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ gnyis pa lha dngos kyis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la/ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita sogs tshar gcig brjod la/ gtor ma 'di nyid sngar yod gsal gdab pa'i tshul gyis khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog rol pa'i skur gsal ba'i steng gi nam mkhar slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma/ g.yas su dpa' bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ g.yon du dpa' mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mtha' skor kun du bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho/ nor lha gter bdag gis tshogs kyis bskor ba khyed rang rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs/ 'ur 'ur chem chem bzhugs pas gnod byed kyi gdon bgegs sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams zhal du dmar 'jil gsol ba'i mos pa mdzod/ hrīḥpad+ma ta krita sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥtrig nan dzaḥdzaḥ

sa mā ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya dzaḥ sa ma ya bzlog sa ma ya bh+yo/ sa ma ya gtubs/ sa ma ya byer/ sa ma ya rbad/ sa ma ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya/ 'byung po mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dbon ston skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge gnyan ston sbas pa'i rnal 'byor/ 'gro mgon sangs rgyas ston pa/ mkhas grub gtsang ma shangs ston/ mkhas btsun rgyal mtshan 'bum pa/ khyung po tshul khrims mgon po/ bya btang ri khrod ras chen/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rdo rje/ pha rgod thar pa dpal bzang*/ drin chen sangs rgyas rnam rgyal/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rje bsod nams chos 'phel/ mkhas grub ngag dbang chos grags/

kha skong*/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mtshungs med dam chos bsam 'grub/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'khor lo'i mgon po bkra shis lhun grub/ yang na/ bstan 'dzin lhun grub nas/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ yang na/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bstan 'dzin pa ste/ drin chen rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ khyad par khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i lha tshogs/ gnas gsum gyi dpal bo mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho/ nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba bar mdzad du gsol/ steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag bar gdon btsan dang rmu rgyal 'gong*/ the'u rang*/ ro langs/ 'byung po'i gdon pa rnams nye bar zhi zhing tshar bcad par mdzad du gsol/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye zhing tshogs gnyis mthar phyin te khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ steng gi bla ma rnams dang mtha' skor gyi lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu/ rta mchog rol pa la thim/ rta mchog rol pa 'od dmar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du mer zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi sku lus la thim pas/ khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa dngos su gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ gsum pa ni/ rjes chog kha gsos byin gyis brlabs nas/ slar mdun bskyed la mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba dang*/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa sogs bzod par gsol/ gtor ma dang tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/

dam tshig pa rang la bstim/ dge ba bsngo/ smon lam gdab/ bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// smras pa/ tshul 'dis byin gyis brlabs dang bsgom bzlas la// brtson pa lhur byed nad gdon bar chad las// rnam par rgyal ba snang byed shar ba yi// g.yang lam mun pa'i go 'phang 'jig pa mtshon// tshul 'di gsal bar byed pa'i rnam dkar dge /lus can byang chub sgrub la phyi nang gi /bar chad kun zhi tshogs gnyis mthar phyin nas// rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas thob shog /ces khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags pas mdzad pa la/ bla ma dam pa'i phyag len gyis brgyan te nyams su blang bde bar rjes gnang gi cho ga yid ches pad+ma rā ga'i mgul rgyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sbyar ba dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal kun dga'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// gang gi thugs rje'i zla 'od reg pa'i mod// mi bzad gdon gyis gdung ba yongs bcil ba// bde legs chu gter kun nas 'phel byed pa// dad sgrol seng ge sgra yi sgrub thabs 'dri// de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po skyabs 'gro ni/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum sogs ci nus dang*/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pas skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas/

rang gzhan sems can thams cad la thim par bsam/ sems bskyed ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun seng ge sgra bsgom par bgyi/ zhes lan gsum/ de tsam mi nus na/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// sogs kyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed stabs cig byas kyang chog ye shes tshogs bsags ni/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las seng ge dkar po mgo g.yas su bstan pa gdong gyen du phyogs pa/ ral pa dmar po thur la 'phyang ba/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po// de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ seng ge sgras go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim zhing yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du brkyang ba/ g.yon sku rgyab tu gdan la brten pa/ ral pa'i thor cog bcings shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas logs su sku la cung zad ma reg pa'i tri shu la ljang gu bsgreng ba la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa/ g.yon logs su pad+ma dkar po'i steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang*/ me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i thod pa dkar po can/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ris pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ tshangs skud ma gtogs pa'i rgyan gzhan spangs pa dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su zla ba la hrīḥdakar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rje btsun seng ge sgras rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/

dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ de nyid kyi tshe rigs lnga'i 'od zer 'phro ba'ang grub ste/ dbu'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad/ dpung pa g.yas par mi bskyod pa/ g.yon par 'od dpag med/ dku g.yas par rin chen 'byung ldan/ g.yon par don yod grub pa rnams bzhugs par bsams la/ lha sku snang stong la sems cung zad bzung*/ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig la sngags phreng dkar pos bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ bdag dang klu rnams kyi gtsor byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi bar byas par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsiṃ ha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po ci nus dang*/ thun gsham du/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+ya ā wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satwa ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ā ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṅka ṭe/ ka ro ṭe/ ka ro ṭa/ bīr+ye swā hā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzlas pa'i mthar/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du byon par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta singha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pa d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ brtse ba'i thugs rje'i dbang phyug nyid kyi sku// drang srong chen po'i tshul du bzhugs nas kyang*// 'gro ba'i gdung ba ma lus sel mdzad pa// bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhes dang*/

bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyid pa dang ni bgyid rtsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces dang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa tshar gcig gi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ gtor bsngo byed na skabs 'dir bya/ rjes gnang byed na tshom bu lha bskyed pa sogs dang lung gsum sbyin pa rnams sgrub thabs brgya rtsa ji lta ba bzhin bya/ gang ltar yang rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ zhes gnas gsum bsrungs la/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo ba dang smon lam bya'o// smras pa/ 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgras// sgrub pa'i thabs sogs kun dga'i me long 'di// bgyis pa'i dge bas mar gyur lus can rnams// rtag tu phan bde spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces rje btsun seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs nyung gsal kun dga'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni don grub dbang rgyal gyi ngor/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i gzhung don ltar nyams su blang bde bar ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun 'khyer nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// chos kyi sku las ma g.yos kyang*// bstan dgra 'dul phyir khros pa'i gar// mgon po khro bo bcu gcig gi /sgrub thabs nyung ngu don gsal 'dri// de la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar ram/ mi nus na/ bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// dpal ldan bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas// chos dang dge 'dun thams cad la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// ci nus dang*/

gzhan don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// nag po chen po bsgom par bgyi// lan gsum/ 'gro kun bde ba rgyur bcas ldan// sdug bsngal rgyu bcas bral gyur cig /chags sdang bral ba'i btang snyoms gyur// ces tshad med bzhi dang*/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ chos rnams rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings// suṃ skyes rdo rje'i brag rdzong steng*// e las chos 'byung khrag mtsho'i klong*// hūm̐ byung rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*// rwa gur srung 'khor yangs pa 'bar// badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐/ de nang hūm̐ las gnam lcags kyi// 'khor lo rtsibs bcu sbubs stong brtan// tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūṃ hūm̐/ de yi nang dbus steng dang 'og /phyogs mtshams pad+ma nyi ma ror// hūm̐ res mtshan pa'i 'phro 'du las// nag po chen po lha bcu gcig /sgyu ma ltar snang dbus su bdag /rdo rje gur mgon phyag gnyis kyis// gri gug thod pa gaṇ+ḍi bsnams// spyan gsum zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// ye shes me klong zlum stabs bzhugs// sprul pa'i pho nya lnga sder 'phro// gzhan rnams brkyang bskum gri gug 'phyar// kun kyang mthing nag khro 'khrugs rngam// spyan gsum mche gtsigs mgo phreng dang*// rus rgyan sbrul stag dar gyis bklubs// me dpung klong bzhugs phyi rol du// phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu sprin sogs// dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs bskor ba'i// gnas gsum 'bru gsum hūm̐ 'od kyis// rang bzhin gnas nas rang 'dra byon// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la thim// slar yang 'od 'phros rigs lnga yang*// tshur byon bdag la dbang bskur gsol// des kyang oṃ badz+rī bha wa/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung*// dbang thob mi bskyod spyi bor brgyan// bskyed rim mo// rang gi snying gar rdo rje'i steng*// hūm̐ yig bsrung bya sngags kyis bskor// lha rnams sngags kyi 'brug stong ldir// 'khor lo 'khor bas gdon bgegs bsregs// oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pa ci nus dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi/ e ṣa a pash+tsi ma ka lo// a yaṃ i daṃ rat+na tra ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra ti dzñā sma ra si ta dā/ i dam̐ duṣ+ṭam̐ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ ma ra ma ra/ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ nag po chen po'i gsang gsum gyis// bdag dang sems can byin gyis brlabs// 'khor 'das dregs pa dbang 'dus nas// bstan 'gror phan pa sgrub par shog /gnyis pa bzlog pa ni/ rtsibs bar brgyad du nṛ las byung*// dgra bo gnod byed dmigs nas bkug /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐ drag pos// khro bo phyir gzigs 'khor lo yang*// g.yon 'khor dgra bgegs dum bur gtubs// shā sa na spel tshig btags pa mang du bzla'o// spel tshig ni i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ gnod byed dgra bgegs byad ma thams cad kha kha khā hi khā hi mā ra mā ra sogs man chad dkyus ltar brjod pas chog go /bla ma'i sku dgra bstan pa'i dgra// rnal 'byor bdag la sdang sems dgra// kun gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams// byad ma rang gshed bzlog cing bsgyur// bsad bsgral rnam shes chos dbyings sbyor// 'khor gsum dmigs med kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog go /hūm̐ hūm̐/ lha rnams nang gzigs 'khor lo 'khor// tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūṃ hūm̐/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// snod bcud zhu ba srung 'khor thim// srung 'khor khro bo gdan bcas kyang*// 'od du zhu nas rang la thim// rang nyid rdo rje gur mgon gsal// dpral mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐// dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /nag po chen po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i tshogs// gdul dka' 'dul byed dpa' bo yi// shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis// ma rungs pa rnams tshar gcod shog

/thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul na// zlum gtor zhig bran te/ oṃ las dngos kun stong pa'i ngang*// āḥlas ye shes thod pa cher// hūm̐ las lnga gsum bdud rtsi'i bkang*// hoḥyis dbyer med bdud rtsir gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes pas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas/ nam mkhar pad nyi ro yi steng*// hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung ba'i// rdo rje gur mgon phyag gnyis kyi// gri gug thod pa gaṇ+ḍi bsnams// spyan gsum zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// me dpung klong na zlum stabs bzhugs// sprul pa'i pho nya lnga sde 'phro// bka' srung dam can yongs bskor ba// gnas gsum yi ge'i 'od zer gyis// ye shes spyan drangs dbyer med thim// zhes mgron bskyed la/ ljags las rdo rje'i sbu gu byung*// gtor ma'i bdud rtsi tshim par bzhes// oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum mam lngas phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pa d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhup+pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shap+da āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung ba'i// nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa// zhal gcig mdog sngo cher 'bar zhing*// zangs gri thod pa bsnams la 'dud// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang*// longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing*// zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi// las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol// dam tshig can gyi bdag la srung*// dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod// dus mi 'chi dang nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod// rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan// bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod// 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba dang*// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces dang*/

ye shes mgon po rang bzhin gyi// gnas su gshegs shig badz+ra muḥ /dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim// dpral mgrin snying gar oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dge ba 'di yis sogs gong ltar brjod do// smras pa/ rjod byed nyung ngur brjod bya'i don// tshang bar ston pa'i ngo mtshar 'di// sngon chad ma dran karti ka /sum rtsen gnas su bros sam snyam// 'di bris dge bas bdag gzhan rnams// bar chad dgra las rnam rgyal nas// thun mong mchog gi dngos grub las// dgyes dgur spyod pa nyid gyur cig /ces gur gyi mgon po khro bo bcu dang bcas pa'i sgrub thabs nyung ngu don gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sa skyong dam pa'i bka'i las byed pa bkra shis 'phel gyi ngag 'don rgyun 'khyer du/ gsang sngags smra ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas bris pa shu bha bi dza yan+tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
